title.zh: 将奎松省卢塞纳市陆运署（LTO）奎松发证中心改设为正式发证中心，名称为Lucena市发证中心，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Quezon Licensing Center of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in Lucena City, Province of Quezon into a Regular Licensing Center to be Known as the “Lucena City Licensing Center” and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Quezon Licensing Center of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in Lucena City, Province of Quezon into a Regular Licensing Center to be Known as the “Lucena City Licensing Center” and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trung tâm Quezon Licensing Land Transportation Office tại Thành phố Lucena, Tỉnh Quezon thành Regular Licensing Center với tên gọi "Lucena City Licensing Center", và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะศูนย์ Quezon Licensing Land Transportation Office ในเมือง Lucena จังหวัด Quezon เป็น Regular Licensing Center ในชื่อ "Lucena City Licensing Center" และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Pusat Quezon Licensing Land Transportation Office di Kota Lucena, Provinsi Quezon menjadi Regular Licensing Center dengan nama "Lucena City Licensing Center", dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pusat Quezon Licensing Land Transportation Office di Bandar Lucena, Wilayah Quezon kepada Regular Licensing Center dengan nama "Lucena City Licensing Center", dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) Quezon Licensing Center in the City of Lucena, Province of Quezon is hereby converted into a regular LTO licensing center.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Lucena City Licensing Center, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Quezon Licensing Center. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for the continued implementation of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within sixty (60) days from the passage of this Act, the Secretary of Transportation shall issue such rules and regulations necessary for its effective implementation.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
